title.en: Electric Low Pressure 40 Is the 37 kW Page, Not Electric 40
title.zh: 电动低压40是 37 kW 那一页，不是电动40

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric Low Pressure 40 at 37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa and fine-stone 80 m / 240 m. Electric 40 is 45 kW and 21 m³/h.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动低压40印成 37 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、细石 80 m / 240 m。电动40是 45 kW、21 m³/h。

h1.en: Write 37 kW When the Order Says Low Pressure 40
h1.zh: 订单写低压40时，要写 37 kW

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai keeps Electric Low Pressure 40 as its own page: 37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, fine-stone 80 m / 240 m, Kawasaki 112, 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg. The frame numbers match Electric 30, not Electric 40. Electric 40 is 45 kW, 21 m³/h and 2300 kg. An order that says “40” without “low pressure” and without 37 kW is the wrong sheet. No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把电动低压40单独成页：37 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、细石 80 m / 240 m、川崎 112、3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm、1200 kg。外形数字与电动30相同，与电动40不同。电动40是 45 kW、21 m³/h、2300 kg。只写“40”、不写“低压”、也不写 37 kW 的订单，对的是另一张表。没有印价格。

body.en: This page prints a fine-stone pair only. It does not print Electric 40’s aggregate-13 row of 40 m / 120 m.
body.zh: 这一页只印细石一组。它不印电动40的 13 骨料行 40 m / 120 m。

body.en: Both print 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg. The motor cell is the split: 37 kW here, 30 kW on Electric 30.
body.zh: 两者都印 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm 和 1200 kg。分开它们的是电机格：这里 37 kW，电动30是 30 kW。

body.en: Path plus 37 kW plus the fine-stone label, to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
body.zh: 路径加上 37 kW 和细石标题，发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

question.en: Is low pressure a switch on Electric 40?
question.zh: 低压是电动40上的开关吗？

answer.en: No. It is a separate page.
The specification list used here does not. The distance label says fine stone. Send your stone size.
answer.zh: 此处使用的规格列表没有。距离标题写的是细石。请发送你的石子粒径。

answer.en: Ask Xingtai. It is not printed.
